name: Matthew Alan Taylor
bio: Matthew Alan Taylor is a Canadian film and television storyboard artist and actor. He first worked in the television industry as a commercial camera assistant in Toronto and crossed over into working as an Assistant Director while living in Ireland. He later got his start as a storyboard artist while working on a television show in Toronto. Taylor is also an independent film director and screenwriter.
